summary: Steep Adsett Street kerb with houses right at the kerb.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 1-7 m away over most of the stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street; cars park on the west side, little room on this side.
drivers.convention: Angle parking and weekday 7am-6pm no-parking signs; cars park on the opposite side.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m along most of the kerb
sun_shade: Open kerb with tree shade at mid-section.
